description: Use this skill when writing, refactoring, or reviewing production code. It applies NASA/DoD engineering standards to the code and ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules to the prose that ships with it — comments, docstrings, error messages, identifiers, and commit messages. Triggers include: "write", "implement", "refactor", "clean up", "review this code", "code review", "mission grade", "nasa-dod", "safety-critical", "production-ready", or any request to add a feature, fix a bug, or improve existing code. Also use it when establishing coding standards for a project, auditing code for reliability or security, or preparing a pull request.
